input.quote: Vendor warrants that Fees charged to Customer will be no less favourable than fees offered to any similarly situated customer for comparable volumes and terms.
input.rationale: The only MFN runs in our favour (Vendor-granted best pricing), and Section 12.3 confirms we give no most-favoured-customer commitment. No redline; we keep the Vendor-granted MFN.

input.quote: hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: No non-solicit or no-hire binds Customer anywhere in the document; Section 12.3 expressly negates any no-hire commitment. This matches our preferred position.

input.quote: Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form without cause by delivering the written notice specified in Section 29.4. Customer owes only accrued Fees, and Vendor shall refund prepaid Fees for the period after termination.
input.rationale: Preferred position met: Customer may terminate for convenience on thirty days' notice (Section 29.4) with a refund of prepaid fees and no early-termination fee, and Vendor has no convenience right during the term (its rights are limited to breach and insolvency).
